summary: [FE][MT] Verify the user with View All Daily Report Item sees the Actual (%) colors (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify the user with View Active Daily Report Item sees the same Actual (%) colors (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify a Job Owner cannot see the Daily Report table of a Plan that is not Active (NEG)
[FE][MT] Verify Actual (%) lower than Plan (%) is red (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify Actual (%) higher than Plan (%), not 100%, is green (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify Actual (%) equal to Plan (%) below 100% is black, including 0% and 0% (BND)
[FE][MT] Verify Actual (%) 100% is black whatever the Plan (%) is (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify the color for each Plan/Actual pair at the edge values (BND)
[FE][MT] Verify the color rule applies at every level of the table (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify a parent row takes its color from its own Actual (%) and Plan (%), not from its children (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify the color changes at once when Actual (%) is changed (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify the colors follow the new date when the execution date is changed (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify no old color stays after quick date switching and a reload (NEG)
[FE][MT] Verify no legend and no 'behind schedule only' filter were added (NEG)
[FE][MT] Verify the exported PDF shows the same Actual (%) colors as the screen (POS)
[FE][MT] Verify an empty Plan (%) or Actual (%) keeps the default font color (NEG)
[FE][MT] Verify the colors follow the values as shown on the screen, not the stored decimals (BND)
[FE][MT] Verify the Total row of the PDF Progress Summary table has no color (POS)
